thread:
carlos: P0 - seeing model load failures in eu-west1 after the last rollout. Backpressure on inference queues. Root cause looks like config drift: memory_alloc flag was set incorrectly on a subset of dedicated nodes. Need a hotfix to pin runtime and fix the config. Requesting expedited approval to skip canary and a 30m change window. Anyone available to sign off?

deploy-bot: Deploy request created: deploy/rdw-hotfix-config-drift. Target: v2.3.1-hotfix. Actions: pin runtime, patch config, rolling restart. CI: unit/integration green, perf-tests flaky (low). Approvers required: 2 SRE/ops or Eng lead + Ops.

ops-oncall: oncall here — saw OOM traces and memory allocation spikes. +1 expedite. Request rollback healthchecks: if tok/sec drops >15% OR error_rate >5% sustained for 10m, auto-rollback. Also collect logs: `rdw collect-logs --window 15m --labels hotfix-2009876543`.

alice: alice: I can approve from eng. Need a quick smoke plan: 50 request inference smoke, 95th latency <500ms. Who will run smoke?

diane: diane: tagging PM @pm-lina — this touches EU cluster, skipping canary will affect small percent of EU traffic. PM signoff needed.

pm-lina: pm-lina: acknowledged. OK to skip canary for 30m change window given availability priority. Keep me posted.

bob: bob: Approve from infra. I'll be on the incident bridge and ready to trigger rollback.

emily: emily: ops + eng leads approved. I'm going to kick the deploy.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: starting deploy at 2009876548: `rdeploy run --job rdw-hotfix-config-drift --pin=runtime-config=v2.3.1-hotfix --canary=false --change-window=30m`

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: step 1/4 — patching runtime config on pool eu-west1-dedicated-1: 3/3 nodes updated (2009876555)

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: step 2/4 — rolling restart of inference agents with MEMORY_ALLOC=0.85 (2009876560)

alice: alice: smoke test started (50 reqs) against /generate and /health. Running automated 95th pct latency checks now.

emily: emily: watching logs — no OOM traces after config patch. Latency looks stable in dashboards.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: healthcheck @ 2009876575: error_rate=0.4% (threshold 5%), tok/sec change +2% (threshold -15%) — continuing rollout.

carlos: carlos: good. keep close monitoring. If metrics deviate, rollback per ops criteria above.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: deploy complete — rollout 100% at 2009876580. Runtime pinned to v2.3.1-hotfix.

ops-oncall: ops-oncall: monitoring during 30m window, will post final signoff when passed.

emily: emily: suggested release note snippet: "hotfix: fix memory_alloc misconfiguration causing OOM on dedicated eu-west1 nodes; pinned runtime to v2.3.1-hotfix; rollback triggers: error_rate >5% or tok/sec drop >15% for 10m" — please add to release notes.

pm-lina: pm-lina: confirmed no user-facing change expected. Good to close once ops signoff.

ops-oncall: ops-oncall: 30m window elapsed, metrics stable, no regressions observed. Signoff: green. :white_check_mark:

bob: bob: will spin up a short postmortem doc — blameless, root cause: infra deploy script changed memory_alloc default. I'll create a short remediation checklist and follow-up item.

carlos: carlos: thanks everyone. Closing thread.
